text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The weather forecast called for
clear skies
today, but perhaps I should
purchase an umbrella
before heading
home.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Then again, I've heard Japanese weather
reports
are remarkably accurate.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I shall put my trust in it today.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
However, the sky grows darker by the
minute
until...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Argh! This is horrible! It wasn't supposed
to rain
today!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш's clothes and spirit are
thoroughly
drenched as the rain douses
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
